description: This file defines several interfaces related to device control and management within the WPEFramework, including system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime, and metadata interfaces. It uses COM-like virtual inheritance and includes detailed method descriptions for device reboot, environment query, discovery start, configuration persistence, plugin state management, and more.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as reboot, delete, clone, and environment variable access.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations including starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration persistence and retrieval based on callsign.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle including activation, deactivation, suspension, and notifications.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing metadata about proxies, status, connections, process info, and versions.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates network discovery using SSDP with a TTL parameter.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Provides SSDP network discovery results.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin lifetime notification sink.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin lifetime notification sink.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin by callsign.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin by callsign.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Sets a plugin as unavailable for interaction.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Puts a plugin into Hibernate state with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin by callsign.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides currently running proxy details.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin, including configurations.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides active connection details.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides framework process information, such as worker pool details.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides active subsystem details.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides the hash and human-readable version of WPEFramework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides callstack information for the given thread index.
